name: DESY Hamburg campus
notes: DESY's PETRA IV location page puts DESY in Bahrenfeld: "The DESY research and technology centre, parts of the University of Hamburg and other top scientific institutes already ensure that the Bahrenfeld location has international appeal."

summary.plain: DESY's main campus in the Bahrenfeld district of Hamburg, Germany.
summary.technical: DESY's main site in Hamburg-Bahrenfeld, Germany; a second DESY site exists at Zeuthen near Berlin, which has no site record of its own in the Atlas.
